name: More save options
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
Skips the title screen and goes directly to New Game option. This way you can handle your title screen from an empty map, completely customizable with default engine commands or other plugins. Also adds extra options to check if a save slot exists and to delete it.

Note: the Load Game scene was meant to be used from the title screen only, so it still draws the default title screen background when called. One simple workaround is to set the title screen background to an empty (transparent) png.

commands.name: Save slot
commands.description: Save the game to a given slot

commands.name: Load slot
commands.description: Load a game from a given slot. Plays accept/reject sound

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: ID of the slot to be permanently deleted

commands.name: Slot exists?
commands.description: Checks if the save slot exists, stores the result in a variable

commands.name: Get slot variable
commands.description: Get a variable from a given save slot

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: The save file slot to get info from (if empty, returns empty text: "")

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: The ID of the variable to retrieve

defaultParameters.name: result
defaultParameters.description: The ID of the variable in the current game to store the result

commands.name: Copy variables
commands.description: Copy a list of variables from a save file into the current game

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: The save file slot to get info from (if empty, returns empty text: "")

defaultParameters.name: list
defaultParameters.description: List of variables to copy by ID
